==Acquisition==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
*[[The Smell of Titan in the Morning]] (from [[Captain Langmar]] in [[Grothmar Wardowns]])

== Notes ==
* This skill does not only increase the damage from attacks. It increases all armor-respecting damage. For example: 
** It will increase the damage of [[Stoning]] but not [[Obsidian Flame]]. 
** It will increase the damage of skills that deal damage indirectly, such as [[Smoldering Embers]], [[Spike Trap]] and [[Fire Storm]], but not from similar skills inflicting armor ignoring damage such as [[Wastrel's Demise]] or [[Chaos Storm]]. 
** For non-attack skills, it will not increase typed armor-ignoring damage, such as [[Holy damage]] or [[Shadow damage]]. It also does not increase the physical damage from [[Splinter Weapon]] or [[Whirling Defense]].
** {{anomaly|Attack skills that deal entirely armor-ignoring damage, such as Banishing Strike, are still increased.}}
* The bonus damage is [[Armor-ignoring]]. 
* The bonus damage is dealt as long as the damage dealer remains standing in the ward; damage from ranged physical attacks as well as from [[area damage over time]] skills, such as [[Fire Storm]] or [[Spike Trap]], increases while the caster stands in the ward, and will decrease if they leave it.
* The bonus damage is part of the original damage [[packet]] (e. g. [[Barbs]] and [[Mark of Pain]] will not trigger again on physical attacks).
